program: Wingless fixed-capacity repaired prediction to confidence-gated refined reasoning readout
question: Can one training-only fixed intra-class probability-margin gate expose the same-class predictive gains identified by R3 without adding relation state or adaptive readout capacity?
hypothesis: Keep the sealed 512-motif representation, repaired relation, eight fixed 64-motif classes, support threshold, runtime cap, and horizons unchanged. Compute one scalar gate threshold before heldout scoring: the median normalized top1-versus-runner-up motif probability margin within the repaired top1 class over training-prefix depth-3 queries. On heldout depth-3 queries, expose the repaired exact top motif only when its normalized within-class margin meets that frozen threshold; otherwise retain the existing eight-class distributional answer. The gate will activate on at least 0.75 of the exact 19 R3 same-class hidden-gain rows, achieve at least 0.90 exact precision when open, and open on no more than 0.75 of all heldout depth-3 queries.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Every same-class hidden gain contains usable repaired within-class probability signal. A fixed training-derived confidence gate can now test whether that signal can be exposed selectively without adding learned capacity.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.refined_readout: byte-identical fixed eight training-rank classes of 64 motifs each

margin_gate.threshold_population: all valid repaired depth-3 training queries
margin_gate.per_query_margin: (top repaired motif probability minus second-highest motif probability within the repaired top motif's fixed class) divided by total repaired probability mass of that class
margin_gate.threshold: median per-query margin; arithmetic mean of the two middle values for even count
margin_gate.heldout_gate: open iff heldout repaired per-query margin is greater than or equal to frozen training threshold

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and the frozen hidden-recovery, precision, and bounded-activation thresholds all pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes, the gate activates on at least one same-class hidden gain, and gate exact precision exceeds 0.50, but one or more supported thresholds fail.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the gate exposes no same-class hidden gain or gate exact precision is at most 0.50.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, relation identity, class assignment, training-only threshold, determinism, capacity, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact qualified supported R3 parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and external manifest.
Representation, baseline relation, repaired relation, fixed eight-class assignment, support threshold, runtime cap, and horizons are unchanged.
The scalar threshold is computed only from training-prefix repaired depth-3 distributions and frozen before heldout scoring.
Heldout labels affect scoring only and never threshold selection or gate behavior.
The R3 same-class hidden-gain population reproduces exactly at 19 rows.
The gate adds no learned parameter, class, relation state, tokenizer, parser, or adaptive update.
Duplicate complete probes are byte-identical and probability mass remains normalized within tolerance.
No external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, repair rule, support threshold, class assignment, training-margin definition, median threshold rule, gate inequality, 0.75 hidden-recovery floor, 0.90 precision floor, 0.75 activation ceiling, runtime cap, horizons, metrics, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: compose multiple training-frozen predicates over the confidence-gated repaired predictive state without changing relation capacity

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute gate false positives and missed same-class gains before changing threshold form or capacity
